messages:
anna: heads up — p99 latency jumped ~2.5x for the ql2-v3 model variant after today's canary. Rollout started ~1954321900. Throughput steady but latency tail and queuing climbed. Seeing kernel mis-selection + KV cache churn. Any quick theories? :thinking:

mike: saw that on the dashboard. seq-len distribution shifted right after the tokenizer whitespace tweak (median 40 -> 72). Batcher is picking q4_kv_packed kernels for most requests but profiler shows fallback execs to fp32_attn on the hot path.

jules: can you paste the profiler snippet + which hosts are affected? possible noisy neighbor or hot shard? :mag:

anna: quick summary from host gpu-22 and gpu-23:
```
P99 80ms -> 210ms
Batch sizes: mode=1, mean=3.2
Kernel chosen: q4_kv_packed
Kernel executed: fp32_attn
KV cache hitrate: 98% -> 81%
Hosts: gpu-22, gpu-23
Observations: repeated small batches, lots of cache misses, kernel fallback traces in runtime logs
```

sam: that pattern screams tokenization fragmentation -> prefix cache misses -> recompute + kernel fallback. Small batches are forcing the autoselect to pick low-batch kernels but then runtime detects tensor layout mismatch and falls back to fp32 path which is expensive. Not noisy neighbor yet, looks more like request shape change.

mike: can you run this on gpu-22 and attach output?
```
./bin/profiler --host gpu-22 --pid $(pgrep redwood-runtime) --samples 500 --stacks --out /tmp/prof-gpu22.txt
python tools/seq_hist.py --input /tmp/request-sizes.log --out /tmp/seq-hist.json
```
I pulled a seq histogram already from the canary: 
```
seq_hist: {"0-16": "8%", "17-64": "42%", "65-128": "37%", ">128": "13%"}
```

anna: uploaded /logs/1954321987/profiles/prof-gpu22.txt. Quick grep shows repeated traces like:
```
select_kernel(q4_kv_packed) -> exec(fp32_attn) // reason: tensor_stride_mismatch, kv_layout=nonpacked
fallback_reason: kv_stride_mismatch
```

jules: kv stride/layout mismatch will force expensive path. Short-term mitigation: pin canary to ql2-alt (older quant kernel variant) and revert the tokenizer whitespace change. @deploy-bot can we pause the canary and prevent further rollouts?

deploy-bot: Canary status: v3.4 (ql2-v3) pause triggered at 1954322030 due to latency alert. Currently at 20% traffic. Manual action required to rollback.

sam: propose an interim runtime change: tweak batcher heuristic to prefer kernels with recent successful execs for small batches. Patch will prefer fallback-safe kernel when batch_size < 4 or when exec_failure_rate > 0.5% in last 5m. I'll open a quick PR to validate.

mike: also propose tokenizer normalization: collapse repeated whitespace and normalize leading/trailing spaces to improve prefix cache matching. Low-risk change and should reduce token fragmentation.

anna: sounds good. I'll keep canary paused and monitor. If no improvement in 30m we'll roll back manually. Please link PRs and perf traces. :thumbsup:

mike: filed PRs: #2213 (batcher heuristic to prefer fallback-safe kernel), #2214 (tokenizer normalize repeated spaces). Attaching perf traces and repro script: /repro/1954321987/repro.sh

anna: adding SRE to watch logs and will notify if rollback starts. thanks all.
